To achieve these objectives, the study relied on the descreptive approach step and the social recall technique from Paul Vergés (1992) on a purposeful sample of 1133 students whose 523 males and 610 females at the Algiers’s middle school with iys four levels. The results of study showed that the bodility violence and moral violence are located at the level of the central core. It also concluded the absence of difference in social representations liked to gender as well as to educational level.
